title: Two Earths, One Grocery Store
evidence_boundary: The two Earths are a storytelling device for contrasting states of attention and behavior, not a claim that a grocery store occupies two physical dimensions.
desired_movement: From believing circumstances determine reality to seeing how attention and behavior create very different experiences inside the same circumstances.
grounding: The story does not deny prices, stress, or other external facts. It focuses on how interpretation and response change the experience shared with others.
invitation: During your next public errand, notice whether you are adding tension or making the space easier to move through.
end_card_question: Which version of the room are you helping create?
voice_standard: Tell this like a personal story to a close friend. Use amused honesty in the first half, no moral superiority, then grow thoughtful and clear as the lesson appears. Keep the ending practical, warm, and lightly challenging.
